author: pep-m-classes-objects-sme-review (independent Java/OOP subject-matter critic; recorded by pep-m-java-foundations-classes-and-objects (Claude Opus 5.5, artifact author))

findings.claim: Page completion latches through Restart: a failed required activity after Restart still reports the topic complete.
findings.recommendation: Recompute completion and route settlement from the activities in complete() and Restart; add a behavior regression.

findings.claim: The Activity 3 throw check accepts a bad-value guard joined with && and an empty above-30 branch, so a setter that never throws earns credit.
findings.recommendation: Require the comparisons to govern the throw; refuse && between the out-of-range tests.

findings.claim: A correct in-range guard that stores in the then branch and throws in the else branch is refused and costs tries.
A distractor feedback says the code changes the caller value, which pass-by-value contradicts.
